attributes.description: Milestone 6.2 (id 28; read it in full): vendor-neutral models + parsers/adapters for ITSM/CMDB (change sync by ticket id, CI publishing), GRC (control -> query evidence), SIEM (inputs, detections, retention), PAM (safes/accounts/rotation refs), PKI/CA (issuers, templates, CRL/OCSP), firewall managers (rule import/export); the vendor is a value in the DB, adding one means adding a parser. Started 2026-10-15 (user asked to keep idle workers busy). THIS TASK IS READ-ONLY: no source changes. Survey what the record already holds for each family (governance change records/incidents/approvals, estate controls/frameworks/POA&M/exceptions/responsibilities, observability log destinations/streams/alerts, secret references + CyberArk/Vault adapters, pki domain, infrastructure firewall + PAN-OS/F5 appliance add-ons, external services), what the operations layer and import/collect contracts already offer, and propose: (1) how to split 6.2 into sub-milestones (one per family or by shared mechanism), ordered by value and dependency (7.1/7.4/7.7 interplay noted); (2) for the first slice: the neutral model (classes/attributes, reusing existing ones first; say which core domain), the parser/adapter contract (import format, what is matched, what a sync writes, governed writes), what a vendor adapter package would contain, the reports/planner checks, and a showcase story; (3) what needs vendor facts that must be researched (the master routes research). Deliver the proposal in your done message (it goes to the user); write no notes on your branch except tracking. Rules 2991. Boundary: read anything; AIMFP DB items on task only. No web research.
